purpose: Keep taste as the eligibility base while respecting the user's limited monthly budget: 500 RUB is the normal target, 750 RUB is the absolute ceiling, and the highest overage band is reserved for exceptionally strong fit plus a very large discount.

commercial_visibility_gate.note: A discount of 5% or less is treated as commercially meaningless for this system.

rules: price <= 500 RUB is within the normal budget target after the symbolic-discount gate
500 < price <= 650 RUB is allowed only when the deal has strong value support from price history
650 < price <= 750 RUB is allowed only for strong taste fit, discount >= 75%, and record or near-record history when exact history is available
price > 750 RUB is always excluded regardless of taste or discount
price <= 500 RUB is within the normal budget target after the symbolic-discount gate
500 < price <= 550 RUB is allowed only for record or near-record value
price > 550 RUB is excluded for moderate taste fit

user_price_tolerance.family_fit_rule: Use the final canonical taste fit. Discount and price can never upgrade taste fit.

history_quality.previously_free: Use the distinct previously_free class; never compute a paid delta from zero.
history_quality.unavailable_exact_history: Use unverified; do not invent a historical minimum.
